Claude Managed Agents sessions that run in a self-hosted sandbox can now attach memory stores.
s: The Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK workers download each attached store into the sandbox at its mount_path and sync the agent’s changes back to the store.

t: We’ve added the anthropic-workspace-id response header to the Claude API.
s: It carries the wrkspc_-prefixed ID of the workspace that the request’s API key or access token resolved to, including your organization’s Default Workspace.

t: Claude Managed Agents sessions can now load skills from a GitHub repository.
s: When a session mounts a repository, any skills in its root .claude/skills directory are discovered automatically at session start and available to the agent for that session.

t: You can now set a budget on a Claude Managed Agents session: a hard cap on the session’s spend, priced at public list rates.

t: You can now control where model inference runs for a Claude Managed Agents agent.
s: Set inference_geo inside the model object when you create the agent (see Pin the inference geo), or override it for a single session.

t: Skill and plugin security scanning (beta)
s: Enterprise plans can now turn on skill and plugin security scanning to automatically check third-party skills and plugins for malicious content when someone uploads or edits them.

t: We’ve retired the Claude Opus 4.1 model (claude-opus-4-1-20250805).
s: All requests to this model on the Claude API will now return an error. We recommend upgrading to Claude Opus 5. Researchers can request ongoing access through the External Researcher Access Program.
